name: User interview topics
description: User interview topics capabilities. Includes Add a single interviewee to this topic, Create up to 500 interviewee context rows for a topic in a single request, Generate (if needed) and email a personalized public interview link to every targeted interviewee on this topic whose identifier is an email address, Generate one public interview link per targeted interviewee, Get-or-create a single non-personalised (shared) interview link for this topic, Per-interviewee extra context for a user interview topic, Planned user interview topics: who we want to target and what we want to ask about., Remove an interviewee from this topic, and 4 more.
